whatThisIs: KRX-listed tickers (KOSPI+KOSDAQ, 2765 rows as of 20260907) joined to DART corporate filings by ticker, with preferred shares re-linked to their common-share parent by name. Not investment advice.

columns.ticker: KRX 6-digit code (or alphanumeric for some preferred classes).
columns.name_en: DART-filed English name. Null if not matched. For preferred shares, parent company name + "(preferred)".
columns.dart_corp: DART corp code (8 digits). Null if not matched to any DART filer.
columns.industry_code: DART-filed KSIC industry code (Korean govt classification). Fine-grained (630+ codes storewide) — see industry_name_ko/en for the grouped label actually used.
columns.industry_name_ko: Industry name as DART files it, Korean (60 distinct labels across our matched universe).
columns.industry_name_en: English label, hand-mapped from KSIC standard nomenclature (src/data/korea-industry-name-english.json) — not machine translation. Null if industry_name_ko has no entry yet in that file (see notMeasured).
columns.is_preferred_share: true if this ticker is a preferred-share class of another listed company.
columns.parent_ticker: For preferred shares only: the common-share ticker of the same company.
columns.entity_type: spac | reit | preferred_share | null. Only set when dart_status is not_matched or matched_via_parent.
columns.dart_status: matched (direct ticker match) | matched_via_parent (preferred share, linked by name) | not_matched (no DART filing found — see entity_type).
columns.close_price_krw: KRX closing price, price_as_of date. Null if not available.
columns.price_as_of: Trading date of the price columns.

notMeasured: English industry-name dictionary — all industry_name_ko labels in this run are covered.
Preferred shares not linked (3) — name-strip did not find a matching common-share row this run.
SPACs (30) and REITs (1) — kept as separate master rows; not linked to any DART corp (most SPACs/REITs do file with DART, this is a name-based miss, not a decision to exclude them).
Newly-listed/split companies (25) — DART company list dated 2026-08-05, stale. 2번 is refreshing per P2-A; re-run after refresh.
disclaimer: Not investment advice. Market cap reflects capital intensity, not productivity.
